features.name: Mill Of Murtle, Aberdeen
features.fullDescription: Mid 19th century. Rubble-built, 2-storey and loft, large kiln with forearm weathervane and disused 20' overshot iron framed wheel; modern addition and 2nd kiln. In use, workings completely modern. Converted to restaurant and gallery.

features.name: Dovecot, Milton Of Murtle
features.fullDescription: Probably late 18th century. U-plan, boulder rubble with brick doocot of unusual pear-shaped plan. Asbestos roof over court 1970.
